notes.title: Hot Dodge! Update
notes.content:
A wild update has appeared!

In this update of Hot Dodge! three things have been changed.

1. The hitboxes are a [i]LOT[/i] better. You can actually dodge the Broccoli now!

2. A visual indication has been added when you use your shield (Level 6 and onwards). A green circle will appear around your Hot Dog, marking that you're using your shield.

3. WASD controls are available if you Launch The Game -> Rules and Settings -> Press 'S'. [b]Every time you launch the game, controls are set back to arrow keys. Repeat this process if you want WASD controls every time.[/b]

4. An animation plays every time you start the game. This is just for fun. To skip the animation, press Enter 3 times.

Thanks for playing Hot Dodge!
